title: Clinical Research Platform Into Molecular Testing, Treatment and Outcome of (Non-)Small Cell Lung Carcinoma Patients
official: Clinical Research Platform Into Molecular Testing, Treatment and Outcome of (Non-)Small Cell Lung Carcinoma Patients
summary: Open, non-interventional, prospective, multi-center clinical research platform with the main objective to assess molecular biomarker testing, treatment and outcome of patients with NSCLC or SCLC in Germany
conditions: Non-small Cell Lung Cancer Stage II
Non Small Cell Lung Cancer Stage III
Non-small Cell Lung Cancer Stage I
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Patients who meet all of the following criteria are eligible for the project:

* Age ≥ 18 years
* Able to understand and willing to sign written Informed Consent and to complete patient-reported-outcome assessment instruments

Main project (NSCLC Stage IV):

* Confirmed non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC)
* Stage IV (UICC8)
* Systemic therapy
* Informed consent no later than four weeks after start of first-line systemic treatment

Satellite NSCLC Stage I-III:

* Confirmed non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC)
* Informed consent no later than four weeks after start of first anti-tumor treatment (including surgery and radiotherapy) or if first treatment is surgery no longer than 3 months after start of surgery.
* Stage I-III (UICC8)
* Systemic (chemo)therapy and/or radiation therapy and/or surgery

Satellite SCLC

* Confirmed Small cell lung cancer (SCLC)
* Informed consent no later than four weeks after start of first anti-tumor treatment
* Systemic (chemo)therapy and/or radiation therapy and/or surgery

Exclusion Criteria:

none
